title: Q5
description:
Read: Exo 19:10-25, Exo 20:18-21, Deu 4:10-12

The mountain burned, a beast that touched it died, the people asked that the word not be spoken to them any more, and Moses said he exceedingly feared.

a) Zion, the angels, the assembly of the firstborn, God the judge of all, spirits of just men made perfect, the mediator, and blood that speaks better than Abel's: which terror of that mountain does each answer, and which terror is still named at the end of the chapter?
